job.title: Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager (Financial Services)
job.description:
Role: Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager | Operations, Incident Response & AI Innovation

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise security operations (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and cyber defence capabilities.
  • Drive detection engineering, SOAR automation, and AI integration across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, endpoints, and third-party services.
  • Key focus: Incident leadership, MSSP/vendor management, response playbooks, metrics (MTTD/MTTR), and executive risk governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is seeking a high-performing Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager to lead, mature, and optimize its end-to-end security operations and cyber defence ecosystem.
Reporting directly to the CISO, you will act as the organizational subject matter expert for incident response, threat monitoring, and operational cyber risk. In this hands-on leadership role, you will bridge the gap between real-time threat telemetry and executive risk decision-making—ensuring security events are rapidly detected, contained, remediated, and learned from. You will also lead the vendor management of external MSSP partners while leveraging AI, SOAR, and intelligent data enrichment to build a modern, high-velocity SOC function.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Cyber Defence Ownership: Lead the complete operational lifecycle across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, and identity telemetry—covering monitoring, alert triage, incident containment, root-cause eradication, and post-incident learning.
  • Major Incident Response & Crisis Leadership: Act as the operational escalation point during major security events; lead crisis containment strategies, evidence collection, regulatory reporting, and executive updates.
  • AI, SOAR & Continuous Improvement: Champion the practical application of AI, orchestration, and automated triage to reduce alert fatigue, minimize false positives, streamline investigations, and accelerate response playbooks.
  • Vendor & MSSP Governance: Own relationships with external managed security service providers (MSSPs), threat intelligence vendors, and incident response retainers, ensuring SLA compliance, delivery quality, and value alignment.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Work across Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture to embed threat detection models, logging standards, and incident playbooks directly into operational pipelines.
  • Governance & Executive Metrics: Define and maintain core performance metrics (MTTD, MTTR, telemetry health, alert fidelity) and deliver actionable reporting for CISO, Risk Committee, and Board discussions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Operations Leadership: Proven track record managing SOC, cyber defence, or incident response functions in complex, regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Depth in Security Tooling: In-depth knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, threat intelligence platforms, and telemetry architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Incident Management Mastery: Demonstrable experience leading major security incidents, assessing severity, defining containment strategies, and executing post-incident root-cause remediation.
  • MSSP & Partner Management: Direct experience governing external managed security service providers and third-party incident response retainers.
  • AI & Automation Focus: Practical understanding of applying AI, machine learning, or SOAR playbooks to automate security workflows and enrich threat triage.
  • Executive Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate complex technical cyber incidents into clear business risk impact and pragmatic recommendations for senior leadership.

job.title: Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
job.description:
Role: Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager | Hands-On AI & Exposure Leader

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise exposure, vulnerability management, and zero-day response capabilities.
  • Drive modern risk-based prioritisation and AI-driven automation across cloud, infrastructure, and application estates.
  • Key focus: Strategy execution, cross-CIO collaboration, backlog reduction, and executive-level governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is looking for a high-performing Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager to own and evolve its end-to-end vulnerability management and response framework.
Reporting directly to the Deputy CISO, you will act as the organizational authority on exposure management. In this hands-on, high-impact role, you will bridge the gap between technical risk and business reality—ensuring vulnerabilities across infrastructure, cloud, and applications are identified, prioritised, remediated, and reported in a disciplined, risk-based manner. Additionally, you will champion the practical application of AI and intelligent automation to modernise triage, threat correlation, and remediation workflows.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Vulnerability Ownership: Own the enterprise lifecycle across infrastructure, cloud, apps, and third-party services—covering scanning, triage, risk prioritisation, mitigation, and verification.
  • Hands-On Delivery & Response: Manage vulnerability backlogs, ageing, high/critical remediation activity, scan coverage, and emergency response to zero-day exposures.
  • AI, Automation & Innovation: Champion the practical use of AI and data-driven insights to optimise triage, reduce false positives, perform root-cause clustering, and automate reporting.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture teams to embed vulnerability response into existing delivery pipelines rather than treating it as a parallel task.
  • Governance & Executive Reporting: Define and track KPIs/KRIs (SLAs, exposure trends, backlog health) and deliver concise, actionable reporting for CIO leadership, Audit, and CISO/Board forums.
  • Risk & Regulatory Support: Align exposure decisions to organizational risk appetite, manage formal risk acceptances, and drive audit and regulatory remediation actions to closure.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Exposure Experience: Proven track record running vulnerability management and response within complex, highly regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Breadth: Strong hands-on understanding of vulnerability management principles, tooling, and remediation across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, applications, and platforms.
  • Risk-Based Prioritisation: Expertise in context-aware risk scoring (combining CVSS, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack surface, and business impact).
  • Forward-Looking Mindset: Genuine interest and practical experience in leveraging AI, machine learning, or automated tooling to streamline cyber operations.
  • Influence & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear business risk and drive remediation across engineering teams without relying on formal authority.

To Apply
If you are an energetic, delivery-focused vulnerability leader looking to drive modern, AI-enabled exposure management within a fast-paced environment, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.

job.title: Deputy CISO

job.title: Cyber Essentials Project Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview

The position of Cyber Essentials Project Engineer is suited to a junior or developing engineer with practical experience of Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints and customer-facing IT support. Experience within a managed service provider (MSP) or another multi-customer technical environment would be advantageous.

Working as part of a small team, the contractor will help existing customers prepare for Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus assessment. The role is focused on technical readiness and remediation rather than carrying out the certification or acting as an assessor.

Using established processes, tools, checklists and documentation, the Cyber Essentials Project Engineer will gather technical information, identify gaps, complete agreed remediation activities, maintain accurate records and support customers through to assessment. Guidance and escalation support will be available from senior colleagues where work falls outside the agreed process or level of responsibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Support customers in preparing for Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus assessments using established processes and documentation.
  • Gather information about customer IT environments and maintain accurate project records.
  • Identify gaps against Cyber Essentials requirements and recommend or complete approved remediation activities.
  • Review Microsoft 365, Windows devices, user accounts, patching, endpoint protection and device management configurations.
  • Work with customers to resolve non-compliant settings and improve security posture.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers when required.
  • Assist customers through to assessment readiness and provide regular progress updates.

Requirements:

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Windows environments.
  • Good understanding of endpoint security, patch management and user access controls.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing IT support or project role.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Ability to follow established processes and work independently.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.
  • Experience working within an MSP environment.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft Defender.
  • Familiarity with Cyber Essentials or Cyber Essentials Plus projects.
  • Entry-level Microsoft certifications desirable

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer

job.title: Automation Engineer

Location: Hybrid (50% onsite)

We are seeking an experienced IT Specialist to support a major programme of application upgrades, migrations, and future platform modernisation initiatives within a large and complex enterprise environment.
This role will focus on delivering application and infrastructure upgrade activities across both Windows and Linux platforms, while driving automation and engineering best practices. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring applications remain secure, vendor-supported, and aligned with operational standards.
Working closely with application, infrastructure, and engineering teams, you will be responsible for planning and executing upgrades, troubleshooting issues, implementing automation solutions, and contributing to the organisation's wider technology objectives.
Strong communication skills are essential, as the role requires regular collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure applications remain compliant with vendor support lifecycles and security requirements.
  • Administer and support enterprise applications across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Troubleshoot application, middleware, database, and infrastructure-related issues.

  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes and improve efficiency.

  • Design, develop, and support CI/CD deployment pipelines.

  • Support application release management and deployment activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and operational teams to ensure successful delivery of upgrades and enhancements.
  • Provide documentation, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance where required.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience administering enterprise applications across both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Proven experience delivering application and platform upgrades within production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.
  • Strong understanding of application servers, middleware technologies, and databases.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, diagnostic, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Experience working within large-scale enterprise organisations.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps delivery practices.
  • Previous experience working within highly regulated environments.
  • Active SC Clearance or eligibility to obtain clearance.

What's on Offer

  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale application modernisation and upgrade programme.
  • Exposure to complex enterprise environments spanning Windows and Linux technologies.
  • Work with modern automation, DevOps, and CI/CD tooling.
  • Competitive day rate of up to £450 per day Umbrella.

job.title: IAM Architect
job.description:
IDENTITY ARCHITECT – SECURE ENTERPRISE IAM

Job Title: Identity Architect / Lead IAM Architect

Location: Wiltshire (Hybrid – 2 days/week onsite)

Job Type: Permanent

This role requires a balanced senior architect who can drive high-level strategic direction while remaining comfortable working hands-on with identity schemas, APIs, workflow engine logic, data feeds, and live service support teams.

Key Accountabilities & Role Overview

  • Architecture Leadership: Lead end-to-end IAM architecture across development, data, and live service operations; act as the lead technical authority across delivery teams, third-party suppliers, and senior stakeholders.
  • Core IAM Capability Ownership: Drive strategic oversight of Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes, identity lifecycle management, role governance, access recertification, and regulatory audit compliance.
  • Technical & Schema Design: Shape and review detailed designs covering identity schemas, LDAP directories, data attribute models, provisioning workflows, microservices, and API integrations.
  • Platform Modernisation & Debt Reduction: Simplify legacy architecture patterns, eliminate unnecessary customisations, champion API-led integration models, and support roadmap alignment with cloud-native / Microsoft Entra environments.
  • Service Supportability & Operations: Collaborate directly with L2/L3 support and DevOps teams to author runbooks, perform root-cause analysis on complex defects, and ensure seamless BAU service transition.

Mandatory Criteria & Technical Requirements

  • Security Clearance: Active UK SC Clearance is mandatory prior to starting.
  • Architecture Track Record: Proven experience as a Lead, Senior, or Principal Architect owning enterprise-wide IAM solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of identity governance, authentication/authorization protocols, directory services, and enterprise integration patterns within government, defence, or regulated environments.
  • Hands-on Technical Capability: Practical expertise with identity schema design, API interfaces, microservices, workflow logic, and data transformation/ETL pipelines.
  • Location: Ability to work onsite in Corsham at least 2 days per week.

Desirable Experience

  • IAM Platforms: OpenText/NetIQ, SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, ForgeRock, or CyberArk.
  • Cloud & Federation: AWS cloud environments, M365 identity integration, SAML/OIDC, and API Gateways.
  • Frameworks: Secure-by-Design principles, containerised deployments, and automated deployment pipelines.

How to Apply

If you meet the mandatory SC clearance requirement and possess a strong technical background in enterprise identity architecture, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.
